title: Rethinking Pre-pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.40051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. Howeve

translated_abstract: 我们报告称，在算力匹配的实验中，将算力分配给合成数据的预预训练（PPT）从未优于纯自然语言训练。这一结论在四种PPT课程（k-Dyck、神经元胞自动机（NCA）、声明式参考语料库和代码）以及三种训练机制下均成立：数据受限、数据不受限，以及高词元与参数比机制（8.81亿参数在500亿词元上训练）。当自然语言数据稀缺时，对1亿词元语料库进行重复多轮训练在自然语言验证损失上优于所有合成课程，且PPT没有带来一致的下游准确率优势。我们发现先前工作中报告的PPT收益对权重初始化方案非常敏感。在NCA复现实验中，在原始初始化方案下，我们从PPT中获得了5.4%的困惑度改进。另一种替代方案同时改进了两种方法，但对无PPT基线的改进更大，从而缩小了两者之间的差距。
tldr: 在算力匹配的实验中，合成数据的预预训练（PPT）在多种课程和训练机制下均无法超越纯自然语言训练，且先前报告的PPT收益对权重初始化方案高度敏感。
en_tdlr: In compute-matched experiments, synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training across multiple curricula and training regimes, and previously reported PPT gains are highly sensitive to the weight initialization scheme.
